data.long_meaning: The name Gosselin is derived from the Old German word ‘gos’, meaning ‘goose’, and ‘lin’, meaning ‘farmer’. The name likely originated from the term ‘goswyn’, meaning ‘goose friend’, and was common among farmers due to their use of geese for protection and food. The name Gosselin carries the meaning “Goose, farmer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gosselin usually hope their child will grow to embody goose, farmer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
